brief: My balcony is partial shade with moderate moisture, and a cat and a dog live in the household. A west-facing balcony with soft afternoon light filtered through a neighbouring tree. My indoor cat loves to sit among the pots.

design.site_summary: A shady apartment balcony with a friendly cat who loves to graze on safe greenery.
design.layout_strategy: Hanging baskets with trailing foliage at eye level, upright perennial foliage at mid height in containers against the back wall, and low groundcover herbs along the accessible balcony edge.
design.combination_logic: This combination pairs the fine textures of ferns with broad glossy cast iron leaves and delicate low-growing herbs, providing visual contrast in foliage shape while ensuring year-round greenery and non-toxic safety for the cat.

zones.placement: on the east-facing balcony floor within easy reach of the cat, 3 h of morning sun, sheltered from the afternoon heat

plants.why: Low-growing, safe for pets, and creates a dense mat for gentle grazing.
plants.role_in_combination: Provides a soft ground-hugging texture and delicate color at the front edge of the planting scheme.

plants.why: Adds edible flowers and safe stimulation for the cat.
plants.role_in_combination: Introduces bright seasonal color accents contrasting with the surrounding green foliage.

maintenance: Water moderately when the top inch of soil feels dry.
Prune back spent flower heads to encourage continuous blooming.

zones.placement: against the interior east-facing wall, 3 h of morning sun, protected from harsh wind

plants.why: Extremely hardy foliage plant that thrives in full shade and is completely pet-safe.
plants.role_in_combination: Provides structural vertical height and bold, dark green leaf contrast against the wall.

plants.why: Adds graceful palm fronds at mid-height without posing any toxicity risk to cats.
plants.role_in_combination: Introduces fine, tropical texture that softens the rigid lines of the containers.

maintenance: Water weekly during active growth seasons.
Wipe broad leaves occasionally to remove dust and maintain shine.

zones.placement: suspended from the east-facing overhang, receiving 3 h of morning sun and bright indirect light

plants.why: Excellent shade-loving fern that creates a lush, cascading effect from hanging baskets.
plants.role_in_combination: Brings feathery, delicate texture and movement at eye level, completing the vertical layering.

maintenance: Check soil moisture twice a week in summer to prevent the basket from drying out.
Mist fronds regularly to maintain high humidity.

care_instructions.task: Water all containers thoroughly until drainage occurs
care_instructions.frequency: twice a week in summer, weekly in spring and autumn

care_instructions.task: Apply organic liquid fertilizer to mid and hanging layers
Inspect ferns and foliage for dead fronds and prune them off

care_cautions: Overwatering in the hanging baskets can cause root rot for the Hen and Chickens Fern, ensure proper drainage holes.
Tender perennials in the grazing box may suffer frost damage if left exposed during sudden winter temperature drops.
design.pet_safety_note: Every plant selected in this design is 100 percent non-toxic to cats and dogs, ensuring total peace of mind while your pet explores the grazing box.
